status: GAME BALANCE. Tunable gameplay values for simcore/engagement.hpp. These are not performance data for any real system; only the values whose 'source' names a document come from one, and those only set when lamps light.
notes: Change these to tune difficulty. The debrief prints every factor that went into each hit or miss, so the effect of a change is visible.

zone.source: max range, altitude limits: SAM Simulator Osa-AK manual p9, p14; warning time: p29 (ВНИМАНИЕ 15 s ahead). min_range_m is a game value.
zone.notes: Used for the ЦЕЛЬ В ЗОНЕ and ВНИМАНИЕ lamps and the outcome's zone factor.

search.notes: Game value: with СДЦ (MTI) off, targets below this height are lost in ground clutter.

track.source: range_gate_m: half the 1.5 km magnified sweep, SAM Simulator Osa-AK manual p24. The rest are game values.
track.notes: How close the operator must set the azimuth line and range gate for ЦУ АЗ to capture; below min_altitude_m the radar can't hold angles (НЛЦ) and the TV must be used.

aim.notes: Roles: who turns each wheel (flak11, 9A33-3); they are console stations. The rest are game values: how fast an NPC turns each wheel onto a contact. plotting_board_range_m: the PU-12 board is watched from 50 km (manual p21).

missile.notes: Game pacing only: the delay between launch and result is range / average_speed. max_flight_time_s follows the manual's 24–27 s (p27).

outcome.notes: Game values. chance = hit_chance[class] x (TV track ? tv_factor : 1) x (in zone at launch ? 1 : outside_zone_factor) x max(manoeuvre_factor_min, 1 - penalty x target turn rate in deg/s) x max(deviation_factor_min, 1 - deviation_penalty x crew mistakes).
